import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_files_0_to_8 = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_8.csv",
]

# Read and concatenate sources 0 to 8 (union)
dfs_0_to_8 = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files_0_to_8]
union_0_to_8 = pd.concat(dfs_0_to_8, ignore_index=True)

# Read source 9
source_9_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_88/training_9.csv"
df_9 = pd.read_csv(source_9_path, index_col=0)

# Join source 9 with union of sources 0 to 8 on all columns ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']
# This is an inner join on all columns, so effectively intersection of rows
join_columns = ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']
# Perform inner join on all columns
target_df = pd.merge(df_9, union_0_to_8, on=join_columns, how='inner')

# The join adds suffixes if columns overlap, but since we join on all columns, no suffixes expected.
# Drop any extra columns if present (like 'Unnamed: 0' from intermediate_step2)
# Keep only target schema columns
target_df = target_df[join_columns]

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
target_df = target_df.astype({
    'admit': 'int64',
    'gre': 'int64',
    'gpa': 'float64',
    'prestige': 'int64'
})

# Write the final target table to the specified path without index
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
